layout_observed: Legacy F1 2019 Hockenheim Grand Prix layout as represented in F1 2020 footage; use blue/white kerbs shown.
review_scope: 16 sparse overview frames viewed by author. Clip is an edited career/race montage, includes menus/cuts and changing conditions; not a continuous lap. Unviewed timestamps are not evidence.

reviewed_visual_evidence.notes: Main straight and Nordkurve: Motodrom main stand has red seats and repeated swooping/cantilever roof bays; pits opposite have deep overhang and narrow upper glass band. Blue/white edge kerbs and blue outer apron.

Einlauf and short approach: Short grass verges, close catch fence and low service buildings. Wide corner-specific escape apron, forest horizon; no city skyline.

Mobil1 and Sachs stadium entry: Motodrom enclosing curved grandstand bowl, white/gray control structures and banked Sachs bend. Blue outside apron, gravel trap and blue/white kerbs; not a flat fenced road.
